title: Agent orchestration
subtitle: Worker (subagent) type definitions and Claude Code-compatible hooks

workers.sectionDesc: The orchestrator spawns helpers from these markdown files (the engine tool name comes from the frontmatter `name`). Defaults (research_worker / code_worker) are seeded on first start.
workers.empty: No worker definitions yet (built-in defaults are in effect; they appear here after you save one)
workers.saved: Saved {{file}}; takes effect after engine restart
workers.editorHint: Frontmatter: name (tool name, lowercase letters/digits/_/-), description (the orchestrator picks helpers by it), model (ai00-auto / ai00-salvo / other ref), background (continuable / one-shot), tools (tool allowlist); body is the helper persona.
workers.deleteConfirm: The helper disappears from the orchestrator's dispatch list; takes effect after engine restart. Deleting all falls back to the built-in defaults.

hooks.sectionDesc: The engine bridge (dsh-hooks-claude-code) reads this hooks.json (Claude Code format), supporting SessionStart / UserPromptSubmit / PreToolUse / PostToolUse / Stop / SubagentStart / SubagentStop: block prompts or tools, inject context, force continuation. Save empty to disable. Read once at engine startup.
hooks.saved: Hooks config saved; takes effect after engine restart

restart.hint: Changes above are read once at engine startup —
